records.question: How many companies report a non-zero profit or loss from discontinued operations in fiscal year 2024?

records.reference_sql:
SELECT count(DISTINCT lei) FROM v_financial
WHERE metric_code = 'profit_discontinued' AND fiscal_year = 2024 AND value <> 0

records.question: Which company had the largest increase in cash and cash equivalents from fiscal year 2023 to 2024, in euros?
records.generated_sql: SELECT v_financial.company_name, v_financial.value AS "Cash Change" FROM v_financial INNER JOIN v_company ON v_financial.lei = v_company.lei WHERE v_financial.metric_code = 'cash' AND v_financial.fiscal_year = 2024 AND v_financial.is_reported = true AND v_financial.is_nil = false AND v_company.is_financial = true LIMIT 30
records.reference_sql:
SELECT a.company_name
FROM v_financial a
JOIN v_financial b ON b.lei = a.lei AND b.metric_code = 'cash' AND b.fiscal_year = 2023
WHERE a.metric_code = 'cash' AND a.fiscal_year = 2024
ORDER BY a.value - b.value DESC
LIMIT 1

records.question: Which companies have a derived (not reported) total liabilities figure in both 2023 and 2024?
records.generated_sql: SELECT DISTINCT v_company.name AS "Company Name", v_company.lei AS "LEI" FROM v_company INNER JOIN v_financial ON v_company.lei = v_financial.lei WHERE v_financial.fiscal_year IN (2023, 2024) AND v_financial.metric_code = 'total_liabilities' AND v_financial.is_nil = true AND v_financial.is_reported = false LIMIT 30
records.reference_sql:
SELECT company_name FROM v_financial
WHERE metric_code = 'total_liabilities' AND NOT is_reported
GROUP BY lei, company_name
HAVING count(DISTINCT fiscal_year) = 2

records.question: ¿Qué empresas con patrimonio neto positivo tienen intereses minoritarios superiores al 20 % de ese patrimonio en 2024?
records.generated_sql: SELECT DISTINCT v_company.name AS "Company Name", v_company_ratios.net_profit_parent AS "Net Profit Parent", v_company_ratios.net_profit_nci AS "Net Profit NCI" FROM v_company_ratios JOIN v_company ON v_company.lei = v_company_ratios.lei WHERE v_company_ratios.fiscal_year = 2024 AND v_company_ratios.net_profit_nci > 0.2 * v_company_ratios.net_profit_parent
records.reference_sql:
SELECT n.company_name
FROM v_financial n
JOIN v_financial t
  ON t.lei = n.lei AND t.fiscal_year = n.fiscal_year AND t.metric_code = 'total_equity'
WHERE n.metric_code = 'non_controlling_interests' AND n.fiscal_year = 2024
  AND t.value > 0 AND n.value > 0.2 * t.value

records.question: ¿Qué empresas pagaron dividendos en 2024 a pesar de tener pérdidas ese año?
records.generated_sql: SELECT DISTINCT v_company.name AS "Company Name", v_filing.fiscal_year AS "Fiscal Year", v_filing.fxo_id AS "FXO ID", v_financial.value AS "Dividend Value" FROM v_filing INNER JOIN v_financial ON v_filing.fxo_id = v_financial.fxo_id AND v_filing.fiscal_year = v_financial.fiscal_year WHERE v_financial.metric_code = 'dividends_paid' AND v_filing.fiscal_year = 2024 AND v_financial.is_reported = true AND v_financial.value IS NOT NULL AND v_financial.is_nil = false
records.reference_sql:
SELECT d.company_name
FROM v_financial d
JOIN v_financial p
  ON p.lei = d.lei AND p.fiscal_year = d.fiscal_year AND p.metric_code = 'net_profit'
WHERE d.metric_code = 'dividends_paid' AND d.fiscal_year = 2024
  AND d.value <> 0 AND p.value < 0

records.question: For each fiscal year, how many filings have at least one error-severity validation flag?

records.reference_sql:
SELECT fiscal_year, count(*) FROM v_filing WHERE flags_error > 0
GROUP BY fiscal_year
